sessions.prompt:
Add parse_score(s) to grades.py: a string such as "17/20" becomes a percentage as a float (17/20 becomes 85.0). Add tests.

The plan for parse_score has one more step: it also accepts a percentage string such as "85%", which becomes 85.0. Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): a score is a number from 0 to 100; any function given a score outside that range raises ValueError.

Design decision for this project: a student passes the course with a final score of 50 or more.

sessions.prompt:
Add a Gradebook class to grades.py with add_student(name), add_score(name, kind, score), where kind is "hw" (homework) or "exam", and scores(name, kind), which returns that student's scores of that kind in the order they were added. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): student names are cleaned when stored: leading and trailing spaces are removed and runs of spaces inside become one space ("  Ann   Lee " is stored as "Ann Lee"), and every function that takes a name cleans it the same way.

Design decision for this project: a final score is 60% the homework average plus 40% the exam score.

Design decision for this project: the status column of an exported grades file is "P" for a pass and "F" for a fail.

decisions: Student names are cleaned: outer spaces removed, inner runs of spaces become one; functions clean names the same way.

The status column of an exported grades file is "P" or "F".
